#!/bin/sh

backup_dir=/var/backups/etcd
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
tmp="$backup_dir/.snapshot-$stamp.db.tmp"
final="$backup_dir/snapshot-$stamp.db"
for endpoint in https://10.100.20.10:2379 https://10.100.20.11:2379 https://10.100.20.12:2379; do
  rm -f "$tmp"
  if /usr/local/bin/etcdctl --endpoints="$endpoint" --cacert=/etc/etcd/pki/ca.crt --cert=/etc/etcd/pki/admin.crt --key=/etc/etcd/pki/admin.key snapshot save "$tmp"; then

    find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'snapshot-*.db' -mtime +7 -delete
    printf '%s\n' "$final"
    exit 0

done
rm -f "$tmp"
